title: ChatModeratedChannelsResult
description: chat.moderated-channels-result@1: the answer of GET /internal/moderation/users/:userId/channels on OpenVibe.Chat (capability chat.moderation.read): { ok: true, channels } — the channels one Live user moderates (channel_moderators rows joined with their channels, database.js getChannelsByModerator), so a stream chat can answer 'may I moderate' without asking per message. Empty when the person moderates none. A failure is { ok: false, error }.

title.description: The channel's title, for a label; never required to decide.

owner_user_id.description: The channel owner's Live user id (channels.user_id).

owner_username.description: The owner's handle; a public name, never a profile.
